_doc: FIRST-PERSON defaults for the per-keeper logbook voice. Every writing STYLE in data/voices/*.json inherits this (merge order: data/chronicle-voice.json structural base <- THIS <- the style file), so a style need only override the flavour it wants and still renders cleanly. This is what turns a Story tab into a first-person log handed from keeper to keeper: `pronoun.<kind>.first` makes clauses that open on the entity's own name read as 'we/I', and `handover.<kind>.<cause>` is the note each new keeper writes on taking up the book. Restrained ship's-chronicle tone here; styles supply personality. TOKENS: {name} keeper's name · {rank} rank label (may be empty) · {rankc} '', or ', <rank>' (SAFE optional-rank — prefer this over {rank}) · {type} ship/island type · {ship} vessel name · {home} home port · {place} island name · {population} souls · {bounty} bounty · {ord} ordinal word · {foeName}/{foeHome} a recurring foe. Unknown/empty tokens collapse with adjacent glue.

ship.founder: Here begins my keeping of this log. I am {name}{rankc}, and this {home} {type} answers to me now.
ship.successor: The log passes into my hand. I am {name}{rankc}; her account goes on under me.
ship.mutiny: The crew put the old master over the side and pressed the book on me. I am {name}, green to command, and set down what I can.
ship.pirate: No more honest trade. The black flag is up, and I — {name}{rankc} — keep this log in my own hand now.
ship.prize: She struck to us. I am {name}{rankc}; this hull sails under my flag now, and her log continues at the point of a cutlass.
ship.recovered: A hunter ran us down and the black flag came down with him. I am {name}{rankc}, set to bring this hull back to honest trade — and to keep her book.

island.founder: I take up the governance of {place}, and this record with it. I am {name}{rankc}.
island.overthrow: The mob pulled down the old ruler, and the seal has come to me. I am {name}{rankc}; {place} is mine to govern now.
island.successor: The rule of {place} passes to me — {name}{rankc}. I keep its chronicle from here.

phrases: — not the first I have taken
, another I have sent to the bottom
, the {ord} port I have put to the torch
— I have shaken off wolves before
, the {ord} raider I have run down
— another wolf I have sent under

ship: — the same wolf that took the {foeName}
, the {ord} {foeHome} hull to strike to me

ship.default: I keep her at sea still, out of {home}.

island.haven: It flies the black flag now — a den of cutthroats, and no lawful hand keeps this book.
island.default: The port endures under my hand — {population} souls.

quiet.ship: Little enough to set down — a quiet life on the trade lanes, and I glad of it.
quiet.island: Little troubles this port; trade comes and goes, and I keep a calm ledger.
